outcome: Assimilation of obstetric violence concept in judicial decisions
Attention to the female body in legal judgments
Acknowledgement of consequences within the intimate-relational dimension
Commitment to the principle of self-determination through informed consent
cohort: The study analyzed 5 eligible legal judgments selected from an initial 41 sentences found in the Italian legal database related to obstetric violence until June 2023.
finding: Italian legal judgments concerning obstetric violence frequently prioritized technical aspects and childbirth outcomes, yet showed encouraging progress in recognizing women's bodily integrity, intimate-relational consequences, and the importance of self-determination through informed consent.
mod_finding: One of the specific issues covered within the legal judgments concerning obstetric violence was Vaginal Birth After Cesarean (VBAC).
